headline: PH Women’s Soft Tennis Secures Historic First Asian Games Medal
seoTitle: Philippine Women’s Soft Tennis Wins Historic First Asian Games Medal | FMB News
seoDescription: The Philippine women’s soft tennis team has secured the country’s first Asian Games medal in the sport after reaching the 2026 semifinals in Nagoya.
deck: Bien Zoleta and the Philippine women’s soft tennis team reached the semifinals in Nagoya, guaranteeing at least bronze and the country’s first Asian Games medal in the sport.
author: FMB News Sports Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine women’s soft tennis team advanced to the Asian Games semifinals after finishing second in Group B with a 2-1 record. The Filipinas swept Mongolia 3-0, beat Thailand 2-1 and lost 0-3 to Chinese Taipei.

sections.heading: Why it is historic
paragraphs: Because the team event has no third-place playoff, reaching the semifinals guarantees at least a bronze medal. GMA News and The Philippine Star report that this is the Philippines’ first Asian Games medal in soft tennis.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The Philippines faces defending Asian Games champion and world champion Japan in the semifinals. The medal color remains unresolved until that match is completed.

verificationNotes: GMA News and The Philippine Star independently confirm the Philippine women’s team reached the semifinals and secured at least bronze.
The Philippine Star reports the group results: Mongolia 3-0, Thailand 2-1, Chinese Taipei 0-3, for a 2-1 Group B record.
The medal is described as assured bronze because there is no third-place playoff; medal color remains pending the semifinal against Japan.
Wikimedia Commons verifies the Higashiyama Park Tennis Center photograph as Psjk2106’s own work under CC BY-SA 4.0, original dimensions 4272 × 2848.
The image is explicitly captioned as an archival venue photograph and is not represented as depicting the Philippine team or current match.
